notes.title: 1.0 Update is OUT NOW: new zone, new enemies, and Cthulhu itself!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/60a2943622722de56b98134757ac698bd040e889.gif

Hail to thee humans, 

All of you prove to be worthy challengers, and now the time has finally come: the Great-Old-One, the Only and Mighty, Lord Cthulhu itself will face you in battle!  

It's been a long way, but the 1.0 is finally here and will bring many exciting new enemies, a new zone, the Codex, and tons of quality-of-life improvements. But without further ado, let’s see the full patch notes: 


 Zone 7 + Cthulhu boss Fight.
 Updated visuals and structure of the Manor and the Mind Palace.
 UI visual overhaul.
 Killing foes now gives you small amounts of aether.
 Added a Codex with information about the various locations, creatures, and characters.
 Added subtitles to cutscenes.
 Added Damage/Effect Leveling Side Arms.
 Added prompts for weapon and transmutation unlocks.
 Various Balance tweaks.
 Added additional cosmetics and rebalanced cost.

[previewyoutube=dTkh3zkc4JI;full][/previewyoutube]
SPECIAL OFFER: 
Madshot 1.0 is now available globally via Steam and Nintendo Switch as well with a juicy limited-time discount! 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524550/Madshot/

We hope you can all enjoy this new update, and we would like to thank you all for supporting us until this very moment. If you didn’t do it yet, this is the best time to join our Discord and share your feedback, experiences, and best moments! 

The abyss, and now the Great-Old-One itself, are waiting for you.

notes.notes:

Humans, 

As you know – during this EA period - we have delivered new zones, enemies, upgrades, seasonal events together with bugfixing, optimization and balancing but... is far to be over! *the music dramatically stops* 

A brand new update is available now and it’s your time to show if you’re brave enough to embrace the Road To Madness! 

NEW GAME MODE 

Madshot: Road To Madness – the Madshot’s spin-off that pits you head-to-head against endless abominations - is now available. If you have already purchased Madshot, you can play it for free through the game's main menu. 

EVENTS & ENEMIES 

Event levels - Events now have unique rooms that can be entered on the map, and they no longer spawns in levels.  
Elites - The map no longer has empty rooms, instead it has Elite levels with stronger enemies. 
SIDEARMS & UPGRADES 

 2 additional sidearms 
 6 Upgrades:  
Malady: Toxic afflictions last longer, Toxic ticks increased by X. 
Rattle: Triggering a knockback has an X% chance of spawning gold or health. 
Vanquish: Critical hit bonus damage increased by X% 
Friction: Evading a foe gives it X static charges. 
Tension: Gain X bonus damage for every active static charge. 
Wildfire: Increase your explosion radius. 
We hope you will enjoy this new update! If you want to help us make Madshot even better, join us on Discord to share your feedback and participate in our exclusive beta testing sessions. 

The abyss is waiting for you.

notes.title: Devlog | New Update
notes.notes:
Hey humans,

We’re excited to announce that a new update will be available from the 6th of December, and we wanted to give you a sneak peek at what awaits you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/301f76223d43f0f5cee96ce630dc6eae1d5ca400.png

Originally Madshot was supposed to take place exclusively within Cthulhu. There was no jumping or platforming, and you played as a naked prisoner… Luckily ideas evolve. 

With patch 0.3 you get to experience the zone we initially envisioned, if you can make it past the Coven Mother. We added a few new tools to help you in this endeavor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/6c67502527cdd34cb092796932c6cdb5c17c9ce4.gif

Fight your way through the putrid fleshy hellscape of Chthulus’ innards, culminating in an encounter with the Oculus. It's the first boss we designed, but remains arguably the most fun to play against.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/0db93d79af60e478d46c0db6448d59693608cc42.gif

It’s not only the new zone that’s worth paying attention to. There’s been a complete overhaul of the alterations. Numerous new ones, but we have also modified or rebalanced many of the old.

We focused heavily on deepening the synergies within the game. We also have more curated probabilities, to enable you to create more interesting builds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/726baa85bfe04aaa075d03b46ad6809abe4c85e3.gif

We can’t wait to show you more and hear your feedback, this is just around the corner.

See you in the abyss!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/db66d9db6dc5679927286a2a5a9ca358e438815f.png

notes.title: New Update: Sidearms & Synergies
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/8219df1b5dff5802af8985bb2fd16abfccec9c59.png

Hi humans,

Our journey has just begun - and the abyss is deep - but your support has been incredible and continues to be instrumental. Thanks to your suggestions and feedback we have decided to make the following improvements and changes to Madshot:

Sidearms & Synergies

Sidearms:
Added a new sidearms room that spawns in the map.
Added 8 sidearms with unique functionalities designed to augment your other abilities. 
Main Weapons:
We have reworked the guns to increase variety and encourage experimentation with the new synergies.
Input:
”Drop action” is now "Pickup/Drop action" so you can still pick up objects when you have a sidearm equipped. Remember to use the custom key bindings to suit your playstyle.
Alterations: Paths & Synergies

Alterations are no longer lumped into one pool. Your early choices will unlock new options that compliment your build. Experiment with different starting choices and don’t underestimate what a few “Enhancements” (level-ups) can do.

We have reworked most alterations to encourage creative builds and synergies, as well as added some new ones to make specialized builds more viable.

Added: 
Residue: Toxic foes spawn a gas Cloud on death.
Recycle: Dominated foes spawn a healing orb on death
Rust: First bullet after reload gains additional Toxic Damage
Mender: Dominated foes are restored to full health.
Pandemonium: Foes afflicted with dominate gain more damage for every other dominated foe.
Remade:
Most alterations have either had their functionality or numbers tweaked to better synergize with a wider array of builds and combinations.	
Removed (Or replaced with store items):
Dark Coin
Midas Touch
Dark Touch
Dark Coin
Daze
Flatulence
Others changes

Relics:
”Face of the Abyss” duration has been doubled, and you emit a “curse wave” every 2 seconds.
“Face of the void” now requires half the essence of the other ults.
Visuals:
Updated all the store Items' art.
Updated some old Icons and VFX.
Store:
Various changes to store items functionality and price.
Music:
New alternating track for zone 1-2.
**Warning**
Explosions now damage you as well. But don’t let that scare you off.

We hope you will enjoy these improvements! If you want to help us make Madshot even better, join us on Discord to share your feedback and participate in our exclusive beta testing sessions.

The abyss and all of its crowded paths are waiting for you.

See you there!

- Camilla from HOOK 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/db66d9db6dc5679927286a2a5a9ca358e438815f.png

Our goal is to create a game that will fulfill the expectations of roguelite action enthusiasts. We've put a lot of work into the key game mechanics, and we've also done our best to make Madshot hectically fun. We aim to tighten the experience through cooperation with you, our growing community. Your feedback will help us identify areas of improvement and offer valuable ideas.

So, are you ready to survive the ever-changing road through Cthulhu and beyond? 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524550/Madshot/

Over 50 hideous enemies and menacing bosses.

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hi players,

Between backflips and headshots, thanks to your feedback during the Steam Next Fest the team was able to spot some bugs and start working on improving the in-game experience.

We have decided to keep the demo available on Steam, updated with the following adjustments:


i-frame rolls by default, can be slightly upgraded through the transmutation.
Rebalanced the Chthonian: less health and shorter "wrap around breakout threshold".
More healing from health potion rooms reward from 10 > 25 HP.
More aether from rooms rewards 25 > 50, and from "The Grind" Alteration 2 > 10 (Demo unique alteration).
Reduced "Shield zombie" spawn chance, and they no longer spawns in early rooms.

We hope this can be a good reason for you to jump back into Madshot and explore the abyss and all its crowded paths again.

See you there!

- Camilla from HOOK 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/db66d9db6dc5679927286a2a5a9ca358e438815f.png

If you want to share your experience with us, you can send us your feedback and questions through our Twitter or joining our Discord.
